summary: The customer called to question an unexpected increase in their monthly utility bill. The agent investigated, explained that the previous promotional rate had expired, and successfully resolved the issue by enrolling the customer in a new twelve-month loyalty plan with additional discounts.

evidence.text: Your next bill will reflect this lower rate.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Apply the new loyalty plan rate to the customer's next bill.

evidence.text: Thank you for calling Metro Utilities, my name is Sarah. How can I assist you today?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained an extremely professional, polite, and helpful demeanor throughout the entire call.

evidence.text: I apologize for any confusion regarding the terms of that initial agreement.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent acknowledged the customer's frustration, validated their experience, and offered a sincere apology for any confusion.

evidence.text: I have successfully enrolled you in the new loyalty plan and applied the discounts, effective immediately.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent completely resolved the customer's billing concern by finding and applying a new qualifying promotion.

evidence.text: I see that your promotional rate expired last month, and your account automatically transitioned to our standard monthly plan.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent explained billing terms and the new loyalty plan options with absolute clarity and precision.

evidence.text: Thank you for choosing Metro Utilities, and have a wonderful day as well.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent closed the call warmly, using proper branding and wishing the customer a good day after confirming resolution.

evidence.text: It looks like it was indeed a one-time twelve-month promotional period, but I certainly understand how that might not have been clear at the time.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent accurately reviewed past account notes and correctly identified the nature of the previous promotion.

evidence.text: May I please have your account number and the phone number associated with it?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent adhered to proper security procedures by verifying account details before discussing or modifying account information.
